name: Santiago Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified): 171 recurring closures (all named), 43 early closes, and 6 one-off closures moved to ad_hoc_closures (lesson 13): 17 and 20 September 2010 (Bicentennial), 2 January 2017 (New Year's Day observed), 19 April 2017 (census), 16 January 2018 (papal visit) and 16 September 2022 (National Day bridge holiday), named from exchange_calendars' source comments and marked unconfirmed (no Bolsa de Santiago notice was read). The 43 early closes keep exchange_calendars' times: 12:30 on 24 and 30 December and 13:30 on Maundy Thursday and 17 September where they apply. These are a convention difference from the registry's 2025 early closes at 13:00 (Bolsa de Santiago page); the closing-auction schedule for 2010-2024 was not read, so ADR 0013 is not applied to them. Recent holidays start at or after their creating laws in exchange_calendars (National Indigenous Peoples Day from 2021); the September bridge days (2012-09-17, 2013-09-20, 2018-09-17, 2019-09-20, 2024-09-20) were not re-read against their laws. Corrections: 0. 2025-2026: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications. 2027-2029: recurrence rules. Checked 2026-11-20 (4c10). Last published year: Bolsa de Santiago's own hours and holidays page (https://www.bolsadesantiago.com/horarios) could not be fetched from this sandbox (searches return only press and broker pages), so the 2025-2026 entries were not compared again and the span's first day is marked unconfirmed. Hours (lead, not changed): exchange_calendars closes equities at 16:00 in the southern winter and 17:00 in summer (its close_times change in March and November), and press and DCV's 2014 market note report the same winter 16:00 / summer 17:00 split; the closing auction started on 14 January 2019 (press). The registry's single 09:30-16:00 is kept as one dated entry from 2010-01-01, unconfirmed: no Bolsa de Santiago schedule was read, and the seasonal close needs a modelling decision.
